preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(c == 24 for c in results) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If it is possible to make the final number equal to 24, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.
The number of operations output must be exactly n - 1.
The absolute value of each result c must not exceed 10^18.
